name: CSAT (Prelims Paper-II)
description: Reading comprehension, logical reasoning, general mental ability, basic numeracy and data interpretation.
subject: CSAT

units.name: Reading Comprehension & Critical Reasoning
units.description: Passage inference, central theme, assumption validation, logical corollary.

topics.name: Comprehension & Deductive Inference
subtopics: Identifying Central Theme and Crux of the passage
Testing Logical Corollaries and Implicit Assumptions
Differentiating between Direct Facts vs Deductive Inferences
Understanding Author's Tone, Argumentation and Contradictions

units.name: Logical Reasoning & Analytical Ability
units.description: Syllogisms, blood relations, seating arrangements, coding-decoding, direction sense.

topics.name: Logical & Analytical Reasoning
subtopics: Clocks, Calendars, Puzzles and Ranking tests

units.name: Basic Numeracy & Data Interpretation
units.description: Class X level quantitative aptitude, percentages, ratios, permutations, charts, tables.

topics.name: Quantitative Aptitude & Number Systems
subtopics: Number Systems: Divisibility rules, LCM/HCF, Unit digits, Remainders
Percentages, Profit and Loss, Simple and Compound Interest
Time, Speed and Distance (Trains, Boats and Streams)
Time and Work, Pipes and Cisterns

topics.name: Data Interpretation & Sufficiency
subtopics: Data Interpretation: Bar Charts, Pie Charts, Line Graphs, Data Tables
Data Sufficiency: Analyzing statement adequacy for problem solution
